performance  and  discharge  of  the  powers,  duties

Estate Manager, in terms of this Act;
all  grants,  donations,  gifts  or  bequests  from  any

foreign  as  shall  be  received  by  the  Commission,

the General Treasury;
all sums of money borrowed by the Commission in
accordance with regulations which shall be made
for such purpose; and
any  other  sums  of  money  as  may  accrue  to  the
Commission,  in  the  exercise,  performance  and
discharge of the powers, duties and functions of the
